Create one high-resolution FULL-BODY transparent standing character sprite for the Japanese narrative game 水煙前線 -EN:CODE-. This is the first normal portrait of 針間ヨル (Harima Yoru), a 41-year-old Japanese woman who owns and DJs at SEAM, a small basement club in a Tokyo back alley. Attached images are STYLE references only (the game's adopted portraits): match their polished mature 2D Japanese anime visual-novel illustration, crisp dark linework, restrained painted/cel shading with tactile fabric details, grounded adult proportions approximately 7.5 heads tall, and clear expressive eyes even when reduced to half size. Never copy their faces, hair, bodies or outfits. Not pixel noise, not a chibi, not a teenage idol, not photorealistic, not a 3D render.

One woman only. Full body from top of hair to bottoms of both boots, standing relaxed, mostly front view with a slight three-quarter angle. Tall (about 174 cm), lean adult build. Keep her true age of 41: a mature face with subtle laugh lines, calm long narrow eyes in dark grey that seem to read the room, a composed, warm half-smile. Black short bob with silver-white streaks, the left side of her head shaved short (undercut); small silver hoop earrings. Large plain black over-ear DJ headphones resting around her neck, no logos. Oversized black bomber jacket with a thin violet stitched seam line embroidered down both sleeves and across the back yoke, plain dark grey T-shirt, slim black trousers, chunky black platform boots. Nails painted violet. One hand in the jacket pocket, the other lightly touching the headphones at her neck. Both hands anatomically clean, five fingers each. She looks experienced and kind, never intimidating or seductive. Do not resemble any real DJ, musician or celebrity. No cigarette, smoking, hookah, drink, record, vinyl, mixer or other props, no readable text, logos, badges, background scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, glow, frame or watermark.
